title: Stochastic Dynamics of Generative AI: From Autoregressive Models to Interacting LLM Networks and Neural SDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07065v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on three classes of generative AI models. First, we formulate large language models (LLMs) as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive models with attention-based dependencies. This formulation connects pretraining by conditional maximum likelihood to sequential token generation and provides a probabilistic interpretation of LLM operation. Second, we consider networks of interacting LLMs and characterize their collective behavior through mean-field ordinary differential equations. These dynamics provide a framework for understanding emergent preferential attachment and persistent structural biases, including type-dependent glass-ceiling effects. Third, we consider neural stochastic differential equations (SDEs) as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories, including those observed at irregular time intervals. We discuss their training with particular emph

translated_title: 生成式人工智能的随机动力学：从自回归模型到交互式大语言模型网络与神经随机微分方程
translated_abstract: 本文从随机动力系统的视角研究三类生成式人工智能模型。首先，我们将大语言模型（LLM）表述为具有基于注意力机制依赖关系的高维非线性自回归模型，这一表述将基于条件最大似然的预训练与序列化 token 生成联系起来，为 LLM 的运行提供了概率解释。其次，我们研究相互交互的 LLM 网络，并通过平均场常微分方程刻画其集体行为，这些动力学为理解涌现的优先连接现象和持续性结构偏差（包括依赖于类型的玻璃天花板效应）提供了框架。第三，我们将神经随机微分方程（SDE）视为针对随机轨迹（包括在不规则时间间隔上观测到的轨迹）的连续时间生成模型，并重点讨论了其训练方法。
tldr: 本文以随机动力系统的统一视角刻画生成式AI的三类模型：将大语言模型建模为高维非线性自回归系统、用平均场常微分方程描述交互式LLM网络的集体行为，并将神经随机微分方程作为随机轨迹的连续时间生成模型。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a unified stochastic dynamical-systems perspective on generative AI, formulating LLMs as high-dimensional nonlinear autoregressive systems, characterizing interacting LLM networks via mean-field ODEs, and treating neural SDEs as continuous-time generative models for stochastic trajectories.
